# Vikram Oberoi

> > Technical blog exploring scalable analytics, cost optimization, and engineering solutions with technologies like Redis, Python, and bitmaps.

Vikram Oberoi shares in-depth technical articles on building efficient data infrastructure and product analytics systems. The site focuses on practical engineering solutions for scaling challenges, particularly in retention analysis and event processing.

## Key Topics

- Retention analysis
- Bitmaps and bitwise operations
- Redis bitmaps
- Product analytics
- Cohort analysis
- Cost optimization
- Doist and Todoist
- Mixpanel alternatives
- Python
- Bitmapist library
- Event processing at scale
- Analytics infrastructure
